date_basis: Recorded project milestone dates; older entries are selected milestones, not a reconstruction of every work day.

items.text: Matched the original DailyTalk helper and new native runner on all 40 response-field records and independently transcribed their spoken answers.
Recognized P01 with request-only audio, while its answer invented a folder status without earlier evidence.
Completed and reviewed 41 nested P01 contexts; question meaning survives in 20 ASR outputs and can recover after earlier failures.
Found no complete answer within 19.2 seconds in the 11 contexts containing all required evidence; all 41 contexts nevertheless produce speech.
Fresh sessions still answer an earlier translation topic; clearing earlier ASR changes the reply to a greeting without restoring the folder answer.
Implemented decode-and-clear and constrained listening, preserving native ASR and forcing answer start after the question.
Both methods missed the source facts on two meeting questions, despite generating correct text for the short sky control.
Recovered the first question in question-only replay, showing that the preceding meeting changes request recognition.
Deferred the 21:40 question because the native context limit would discard its earlier evidence.
Shortened the progress report and archived earlier failures, including the invalid single-WAV shortcut.
Ran three real meeting questions at 5:09, 9:21 and 21:40 through DuplexOmni S1 with full earlier audio.
Found no complete spoken answer, although one buffered request produced a correct text answer outside the speech format.
Checked native request packets and disabled the microphone noise gate to preserve quiet recordings.
Reviewed incorrect automatic fact judgments against source passages and added three evaluator checks, bringing the total to 46.
Finished four sequential one-A100 80 GB jobs, using 0.35861 GPU hours including transcription and offline judging.
Completed audio for all 105 retained questions, each starting with the Assistant cue.
Reviewed 20 test questions, added four questions about task owners or changed plans, and selected six clips for testing silence.
Found that the 30B reader gives 13 complete answers with full transcripts but four with the current notes.
Kept 74 earlier teacher outputs out of training and checked five small development fact records.
Proposed separate tests for when to start amortized thinking and what work to do, without running new speech experiments.
Moved the TODO into the project navigation, added this daily log and shortened the main checklist.
Defined the 105-question what-to-think plan, shared chunks, model candidates, token metrics and notation.
Adopted the term amortized thinking, defined every symbol and kept short equations on one line.
Made S1 evaluation-pipeline validation the next gate, before full runs and S2 experiments.
Added a shared experiment checklist and a progress page with a clearly labeled earlier real S1 example.
Changed the thinking-chunk range to 10–40 seconds, with a 25-second target.
Implemented the shared S1 evaluator and passed 43 script checks plus three earlier-output checks, without new inference.
Added visible Experiment progress links under TODO and Experiments, with synchronized checklist states.
Added questions that connect a person to a later promise or compare an earlier plan with its revision.
Added natural question opportunities near five to ten minutes to test growing conversation history.
Generated 40 additional distinct questions from 20 more AMI meetings, with retained questions in 19 meetings.
Used a local Qwen3-30B Instruct reader and tested incomplete evidence as well as full history.
Added earnings-call questions and scripted document lookup examples for later tool-use tests.
Separated distinct questions from alternative phrasings and added the spoken Assistant cue to the current pilot recordings.
Compared three TTS models, tuned requester voices and inserted three questions into paused meeting audio.
Added diagrams showing each question-generation and audio module, its inputs and its outputs.
Completed the first source-checked AMI question pilot using local models and questions written by Codex.
Demonstrated a model-triggered S2 calculation that S1 spoke aloud in one controlled arithmetic case.
Verified one natural interruption where S1 stopped its old reply and responded to the clarification.
Published the S1 reproduction steps, caller comparisons and inference-loop explanation.
